Play the classic guessing game, with HD graphics and animated characters. Play online, with friends or against the computer. Win games to unlock even more characters. 
Features:
• NEW! Online 2 player mode - play with friends or other online players.
• NEW! 24 characters + 24 bonus characters to unlock!
• NEW! Play the new bonus mode: Guess The Animal!
• 1 Player mode - vs computer.
• 2 Player mode (pass and play) - pass device between friends.
• 3 Difficulty settings - easy, normal and hard.
• Universal app - download to all your devices!
• Game Center achievements and leaderboard.
• Automatic syncing of achievements and unlocked characters between devices.
• Animated characters.
• Play as blue or red.
• Intuitive layout.
• Hours of fun!

Download now!

Guess Me is a face guessing game built for two players on iPhone.

Each of you picks a secret character from a board of 24. Take turns asking yes or no questions, flip down the faces that don't match, and call the name when you're sure. Guess right and you win the round.

Two ways to play:

Pass and play. Share one phone and hand it back and forth. Perfect for the couch, the car, or a cafe table.

Online. Start a room and share the code, or let your friend scan the QR code, and play from anywhere.

Twenty character sets are built in: Classic, Animals, Monsters, Pirates, Fairy Tales, Wild West, Dinosaurs, Circus, Halloween, Space, Robots, Superheroes, Christmas, Knights & Castles, Vikings, Ninjas & Samurai, Jobs, Food Friends, Dogs, and Mythology. You can also build custom sets from names you type in yourself, and add a photo to each one, so the board can be your friends, your family, or your whole group chat. Your sets work in both modes: pick one for pass and play, or bring it to an online room and your friend gets the same board, photos and all.

No account and no login. Open the app and play.

Questions or ideas? Email admin@zinance.app.

Premium unlocks Pirates, Fairy Tales, Wild West, Dinosaurs, Circus, Halloween, Space, Robots, Superheroes, Christmas, Knights & Castles, Vikings, Ninjas & Samurai, Jobs, Food Friends, Dogs and Mythology. Classic, Animals, Monsters and your own custom sets are free. Premium is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID, and a subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://zinance.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://zinance.app/terms

Akinator can read your mind just like magic and tell you what character you are thinking of, just by asking a few questions. Think of a real or fictional character and Akinator will try to guess who it is.
Will you dare challenge the genie? And what about other themes like movies, animals…?
 
###NEW###
ENJOY A NEW EXPERIENCE!
Discover a redesigned genie with new emotions and fully animated.

3 ADDITIONAL THEMES BESIDES THE CHARACTERS
Akinator is getting stronger and stronger... The genie has increased his knowledge, and now you have the opportunity to also challenge him on movies, animals and objects!
Will you manage to defeat Akinator?
 
GO IN SEARCH FOR AKI AWARDS
The blue Genie invites you to think outside the box. As you know, he likes to guess characters and to take on difficult challenges. To do that, make him guess forgotten characters who have not been played for a very long time and you may win the best Aki Awards.
 
BE THE BEST PLAYER
Challenge the other players on the leaderboards to prove who the best is. You may write your name on the Last Super Awards board or on the Hall of Fame.
 
KEEP ON GUESSING
Each day, try to find the 5 mysterious characters and win some additional and specific Aki Awards. Complete the full Daily Challenge and earn the Gold Daily Challenge Aki Award, one of the most prestigious Aki Awards.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS
Akinator lets you create your own user account. It will record the Aki Awards you've won and your Genizs' balance. They will follow you everywhere now, even if you change your mobile device. 


PLAY MORE, WITHOUT ANY LIMITS!
THE PREMIUM POTION unlocks all characters and removes all ads from the app, to ensure you get the best gaming experience.

Main features:
-17 languages (French, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Arabic, Russian, Italian, Chinese, Turkish, Korean, Hebrew, Polish, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Dutch)
-Get 3 additional themes: Movies, Animals and Objects

-Hall of Fame with both current and previous ranking
-Last super awards for Black, Platinum and Gold Aki Awards
-Daily Challenges Board
-Add magic by proposing a photo or some questions
-The sensitive content filter

You know this game, let’s play with us in the solo mode or in the versus mode !

Headbands is the charades party game that turns any get-together into a comedy show. Hold the phone to your forehead and guess the word.

A TOP 20 WORD & CARD GAME in the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, and many more countries, loved by players with 4.6 stars from 56,000+ ratings. Thank you!

HOW TO PLAY
Hold the phone to your forehead. Everyone else sees the word, but you don't. They act it out, describe it, sing it, or dance it while you guess. Got it? Tilt your head down for a new word. Stuck? Tilt up to pass. Racing the clock too stressful? Turn the timer off and play at your own pace.

MORE THAN GUESSING
Pick your challenge type: acting, dancing, singing, sketching, describing, and more. Every round is different: charades, drawing games, and karaoke chaos in one app.

FEATURES
• Game Center achievements & leaderboards: compete with friends and the world
• Create your own decks, or let AI build a custom deck for you in seconds
• Play with 2 players or a party of 100+
• Play remotely over FaceTime
• Record your gameplay and share the funniest moments
• Timer on or off – you decide
• Sounds & haptic feedback (vibration)
• New and updated decks added regularly

95+ DECKS, 5,500+ WORDS
The English edition offers 95+ decks with over 5,500 words and phrases. Headbands is fully localized into 8 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish, Czech, Slovak), each language with its own culturally adapted decks. Popular decks include:
• Act It Out
• Animals
• Movie Characters
• Songs from the 60s to the 00s
• And lots more!

Some decks are free; additional decks are available via in-app purchase.

PERFECT FOR EVERY OCCASION
Family game night, birthday parties, road trips, sleepovers, holidays, team-building icebreakers, or a spontaneous round over FaceTime. No board, no cards to lose, no setup: one phone (or a video call) is all you need.

If you're looking for the best charades app, a heads-up style guessing game, or a party game for friends and family, near or far, download Headbands today and start guessing!
